commands.name: screenshot
commands.summary: Save the current output texture or a rendered editor UI frame.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Output file path. Case-insensitive .jpg selects JPEG; all other suffixes, including .jpeg, select PNG. Relative paths are accepted but resolve against the editor working directory; use a fresh full path in an owned folder.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Exact case-sensitive output or ui. UI captures the next back buffer and forces opaque alpha. Output requires a current texture in a visible output window.

commands.result: Object {path:string} echoes the writer's requested path. Known limitation: save/encoding exceptions may be logged but still produce a successful path reply with no usable file. Independently verify the file and decoder result.
commands.effects: GPU readback and image encoding; can overwrite the requested file. Parent folders are not created by ScreenshotWriter. The shared writer's format/alpha state and single pending UI callback make overlapping requests unsafe.
commands.completion: Deferred readback callback. A successful reply alone is not a file-saved guarantee; a timeout leaves an unknown outcome and must not trigger automatic replay.

commands.name: screenshotWindow
commands.summary: Capture the editor window client area using the Windows capture path.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Output path; .jpg selects JPEG, other suffixes PNG. Creates missing parent directories. Relative paths are accepted, but automation should use a full owned path.

arguments.name: region
arguments.description: Exact graph crops to the current graph canvas bounds intersected with the client area. Any other nonempty string is INVALID_PARAM.

commands.result: Object {path:string} with normalized full path on success. The command exists on all targets, but non-Windows capture returns SCREENSHOT_FAILED with an unsupported-platform detail.
commands.effects: Captures the owned OS window, crops and encodes an image; creates parent folders and can overwrite a file. Depends on client-area/window availability.
commands.completion: Synchronous capture and save; errors are returned rather than the screenshot writer's deferred callback.

commands.name: startRender
commands.summary: Start a video export from the current output texture.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Target path must satisfy platform Path.IsPathRooted. On Windows this is broader than fully qualified; supply a full owned path. Export setup can create the parent directory.

arguments.name: startSecs
arguments.description: Requested start time in seconds. Copied into cloned render settings with seconds as their reference.

arguments.name: durationSecs
arguments.description: Duration in seconds; values <=0 are rejected. The handler has no separate finite-number validation.

arguments.name: fps
arguments.description: Frame rate; no explicit handler range/finite validation. Advertised frameCount rounds duration times fps.

arguments.name: codec
arguments.description: Case-insensitive VideoExportCodec name: H264, ProRes, VP9, AV1, FFV1, Hap, HapAlpha, HapQ, Hevc. An unparseable string leaves the cloned codec unchanged; numeric strings are accepted by Enum.TryParse without defined-value checking.

arguments.name: exportAudio
arguments.description: Whether to include composition audio. Requires corresponding exporter/audio prerequisites.

commands.result: Object {path:string,frameCount:integer} acknowledges accepted settings. It does not establish encoder availability, successful completion or file readability.
commands.effects: Clones render settings, requests video export and advances playback frame-by-frame. Requires a valid Texture2D, visible output and ReadyForExport state. Encoder setup can fail later. An existing target may be overwritten; cancellation may leave a partial file.
commands.completion: Accepted export completes over later frames. Poll getRenderStatus and inspect the actual artifact and logs; do not treat the acknowledgement as completion.

commands.name: getRenderStatus
commands.summary: Read current export state and progress.
commands.result: Object {state:string,isExporting:boolean,progress:number,frameIndex:integer,message:string}. Current state names: Undefined, NoOutputWindow, NoValidOutputType, NoValidOutputTexture, ReadyForExport, Exporting. frameIndex belongs to the active session and becomes zero after cleanup; progress can reset to zero. Existing continuous exports can report negative progress. message is human-readable status, not a structured success code.
commands.effects: Read-only snapshot of the existing render process.
commands.completion: Immediate; isExporting:false alone does not distinguish success, cancellation, unavailable output or late failure.

commands.name: cancelRender
commands.summary: Cancel an active export, or report the current status message when idle.
commands.result: Object {message:string}. An idle request leaves the existing message; there is no cancelled flag.
commands.effects: Stops an active export and cleans up its session; partial output may remain. Does not delete artifacts or restore arbitrary caller state.
commands.completion: Cancellation is requested synchronously; inspect status and artifact state after subsequent frames.
